title: Black Friday & store sales tracker input

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Store names or websites, e.g. Macy's, nike.com, Currys. Leave empty to check a built-in list of big retailers in each country.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: US uses Rakuten and TopCashback; UK and AU use TopCashback.

onlyBlackFriday.title: Only Black Friday and Cyber Monday offers
onlyBlackFriday.description: Only save offers that mention Black Friday, Cyber Monday or Cyber Week.

onlyWithCode.title: Only offers with a coupon code

minDiscountPercent.title: Minimum discount (%)
minDiscountPercent.description: Only save offers mentioning at least this percentage off, e.g. 30. Offers without a percentage are skipped when this is set.

keywords.title: Only offers mentioning
keywords.description: Only save offers whose text contains one of these words, e.g. tv, laptop, shoes.

onlyNew.title: Only new offers
onlyNew.description: Skip offers already returned by earlier runs. Use with a schedule for alerts.

stateName.title: Memory name for only-new mode
stateName.description: Use a different name for each schedule so they don't share memory.
